data.name: Aegon Targaryen
data.description:
Aegon was born in 106 AC to King Viserys I Targaryen and his second wife, Queen Alicent Hightower. Aegon was named by his mother after Aegon the Conqueror.[12] He would have three younger siblings: two brothers, Aemond and Daeron, and a sister, Helaena. Although King Viserys now had three sons, he refused to alter the succession and kept Rhaenyra as his heir. Aegon at refused to be a part of his mother's plans to crown him, insisting Rhaenyra was heir.
